units.name: Introduction to Programming
tips: Practice coding daily — even 30 minutes helps build muscle memory.
Use the debugger rather than guessing at errors.
Break problems into small steps before writing any code.

units.name: Object-Oriented Programming
tips: Master encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism with real examples.
Draw UML diagrams before coding to clarify class relationships.
Write unit tests for each class as you build it.

units.name: Data Structures and Patterns
tips: Understand Big-O notation — it drives every design decision.
Implement each structure from scratch at least once to understand it deeply.
Study common design patterns like Iterator, Observer, and Strategy.

units.name: Computing Technology Innovation Project
tips: Start early and document your decisions throughout the project.
Use version control (Git) from day one and commit often.
Communicate with your team regularly and divide tasks clearly.

units.name: Computing Project
tips: Define a clear scope and stick to it — scope creep is the biggest risk.
Schedule regular check-ins with your supervisor.
Prepare your demo and report well in advance of the deadline.

units.name: Network Fundamentals
tips: Understand the OSI and TCP/IP models thoroughly.
Use Packet Tracer to simulate networks and verify your understanding.
Practice subnetting problems until they feel automatic.
